criterion.quote:
# 17. FUSION / EGPU / DGX SPARK / ADDITIONAL MACS

```text
               HAWKING
                  │
           PHYSICAL GRAPH
                  │
    ┌─────────────┼─────────────┐
    ▼             ▼             ▼
 APPLE          FPGA          CUDA
Metal/UMA       HBM/RTL       Spark/eGPU
    │             │             │
    └─────── HMF / HGVAS ──────┘
                  │
               HAWKGPU
```


## 17.1 Fusion law

The target is not to make alien memory domains literally become Apple UMA. The target is to make Hawking code increasingly indifferent to which qualified domain owns an object or operation, while preserving explicit physical cost, version and trust.


## 17.2 Priority order

```text
software Accelerator deepens
→ U50 FPGA school
→ eGPU external-device school
→ DGX Spark / multi-device Fusion
→ broader synthetic machine

This is priority, not exclusion.
```


## 17.3 eGPU school

- external PCIe/device discovery
- BAR/resources
- DMA
- VRAM ownership
- queues/completion
- synchronization
- representation translation
- CUDA kernels
- Apple+NVIDIA physical graph
- HMF/HGVAS
- fault/recovery
- capability-preserving end-to-end benchmark


## 17.4 DGX Spark school

- CUDA differential oracle
- Blackwell execution domain
- large coherent local CPU/GPU memory domain
- Fusion object-space experiment
- representation translation
- multi-device scheduling
- second independent physical civilization against which FPGA-derived laws can transfer or fail


## 17.5 Additional Mac school

- distributed Metal
- distributed UMA domains
- JACCL/RDMA/TB5 baseline when available
- model sharding
- duplicated vs sharded residency
- KV/state placement
- topology-aware collectives
- semantic object-space hiding node choreography


# 18. DEVICE ASCENSION — EVERY NEW MACHINE IS A NEW TEXTBOOK

```text
OLD MACHINE LAWS
      ↓ priors only
NEW MACHINE DISCOVERY
      ↓
MachineGenome
TransportGenome
Kernel microbenchmarks
memory hierarchy
phase behavior
new APIs / neural accelerators
      ↓
re-run physical graph search
      ↓
new laws / counterexamples
```


## 18.1 M5/Metal 4/TB5 future school

- Re-profile memory bandwidth/latency.
- Characterize TensorOps/cooperative tensors/quantized tensor formats rather than trusting feature names.
- Test neural accelerator for compute-bound prefill separately from decode.
- Re-test shared/no-copy and synchronization semantics.
- Re-search TB5 bridge and RDMA paths.
- Do not transfer M3 split ratios, command-buffer assumptions or kernel winners by faith.
